hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Mosaqaf, content, and collaboration.

cta.title: Still have a question?
cta.subtitle: Can't find an answer? Message me and I'll reply personally.

items.question: What is Mosaqaf?
items.answer: Mosaqaf is a knowledge platform aiming to spread awareness and culture in the Arab world. We offer authentic content on management, leadership, and systems, with practical guides based on real experience.

items.question: Who's behind Mosaqaf?
items.answer: Mosaqaf was started by Ibrahim Mahrous, an Operations Manager for UAE brands. The project reflects his practical experience running 9 departments and building systems that run independently.

items.question: Is the content free or paid?
items.answer: All content on Mosaqaf is completely free — articles, guides, and downloadable files. Our goal is spreading knowledge without barriers.

items.question: How do I download files and guides?
items.answer: Every file in the library has a direct download button. No signup or account required — just click 'Download' and the file downloads instantly.

items.question: Are there videos linked to the guides?
items.answer: Yes, every guide is linked to a YouTube video that explains the idea in depth. You'll find the video link inside each guide page.

items.question: Is content only in Arabic or also English?
items.answer: The entire site is available in both Arabic and English. You can switch languages from the language button at the top of the page.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: You can reach me through the contact form on the home page, by direct email, or on WhatsApp. I respond to every message as soon as possible.

items.question: Do you accept consultations or collaborations?
items.answer: Yes, I'm open to collaboration on projects related to management, system building, and content development. Message me and we'll see how we can help each other.

items.question: Do you offer training or workshops?
items.answer: I don't currently offer direct training, but we can discuss custom workshops for your team or company. Contact me for details.

items.question: When does the newsletter arrive?
items.answer: A weekly newsletter arrives every Sunday. It includes exclusive content not on the site, article summaries, and new guides.

items.question: How do I unsubscribe from the newsletter?
items.answer: Every newsletter email has an 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom. One click and you're removed instantly.

items.question: Is the site mobile-friendly?
items.answer: Yes, the site is fully responsive. You can browse, download files, and subscribe to the newsletter from mobile easily.

items.question: Do you accept guest articles?
items.answer: Possibly, if the content aligns with Mosaqaf's message. Send me the article idea and if suitable, we'll publish it with your name.

items.question: How can I suggest a topic?
items.answer: Message me and I'd love to hear. Reader ideas are one of the most important content sources at Mosaqaf.

items.question: Files open instead of downloading?
items.answer: If a PDF opens directly in the browser, right-click and choose 'Save as'. Or use the download button on the file page.
